## Episode Thesis

The episode is mainly political, not about markets. Timbro CEO PM Nilsson discusses the stalled Swedish government formation after the election. He expects that any left-leaning government would be weak and unstable, as Social Democrat governments have been since 2002. The one market-related topic is green steel startup Stegra's new funding gap of about SEK 10bn after the Wallenberg family invested this spring. Nilsson thinks a red-green government would be more willing to fund Stegra with public money, and he strongly warns against the state acting as a venture capitalist.
